title: Wso2am: In Apache CXF, the parser for multipart/MTOM attachment part headers did not fully enforce… (CVE-2026-107937)
description: Security vulnerability affects the wso2am package. In Apache CXF, the parser for multipart/MTOM attachment part headers did not fully enforce the configured attachment-max-header-size (default 300 characters) and attachment-headers-max-count (default 500) limits.
